title: Senior Housing Maintenance Request Form
subtitle: Operational maintenance request intake, evidence, qualified review, exception routing, handoff, and accountable closeout.
description: An original fillable senior housing maintenance request workflow that keeps identity, property-specific observations, evidence, authorization, exceptions, communication, and closeout in one traceable record.
use_case: Use when authorized property staff need to manage a senior housing maintenance request from intake through verified handoff without using the record to make legal, accommodation, screening, compliance, or professional conclusions.

blocks.label: Maintenance Request reference
blocks.guidance: Use one identifier across messages, evidence, work orders, and handoffs.

blocks.label: Property and location
blocks.guidance: Confirm the exact property record before collecting workflow details.

blocks.label: Reporting and routing contact
blocks.guidance: Record only contact information needed to route and update this record.

blocks.label: Reported condition and requested outcome
blocks.guidance: Preserve the reporter's wording and distinguish observed facts from assumptions.

fields.label: Location, symptoms, timing, impact, changes, and requested outcome

sections.title: Urgency, access, and immediate controls
sections.guidance: Escalate danger and plan authorized entry.

blocks.label: Reported condition screen
blocks.guidance: Use emergency services and the property's emergency protocol for immediate danger.
items: Fire, smoke, gas odor, sparking, or active electrical concern reported
Uncontrolled water, sewage, flooding, or active leak reported
Loss of heat, cooling, water, power, sanitation, or essential function reported
Broken lock, glazing, entry, security, stair, rail, or fall concern reported
Moisture, indoor-air, pest, waste, or environmental concern reported
Area cannot be used safely or condition may affect another location
Resident, guest, employee, or public access route is affected
Condition appears routine with no immediate safety impact reported

blocks.label: Triage result and accountable response
blocks.guidance: Urgency supports routing and does not claim a legal or code classification.

blocks.label: Authorized access and communication plan
blocks.guidance: Record consent and operational support without diagnosis or protected-trait detail.

blocks.label: Operational and qualified-review boundary
blocks.guidance: This maintenance request record captures operational facts, routing, evidence, and authorized handoffs. It does not determine legal rights, tenancy, responsibility, habitability, code or accessibility compliance, accommodation eligibility, screening eligibility, or a professional opinion. Authorized property staff must review applicable policy, notice, privacy, retention, fair-housing, safety, insurance, and licensed-trade requirements.

sections.title: Condition history, observations, and evidence
sections.guidance: Link every material fact to a source.

blocks.label: Condition timeline
blocks.guidance: Record dates and recurrence without inferring cause.

blocks.label: Affected locations and components
blocks.guidance: Use one row per distinct location or component.

blocks.label: Photo, reading, message, and record log
blocks.guidance: Do not include access codes, unrelated personal material, or sensitive records.

blocks.label: Prior work, temporary measures, and recurring-condition history
blocks.guidance: Identify supporting references and any uncertainty.

fields.label: Earlier requests, repairs, warranties, temporary measures, and unresolved history

sections.title: Senior Housing context and responsibility
sections.guidance: Apply controls that are specific to this property type.

blocks.label: Senior Housing workflow controls
blocks.guidance: Check only controls actually reviewed; explain exceptions in the routing note.
items: Preferred communication and entry support are recorded operationally
Mobility route, elevator, door, lighting, and call-device impact is noted
No diagnosis, medication, or clinical detail is collected here
Housing, maintenance, resident-services, and emergency roles are separate
Authorized-contact involvement follows the resident's recorded permissions
Temporary access or service support has an accountable coordinator
Accommodation requests route to qualified housing staff
Resident receives repair status in the requested accessible format

blocks.label: Responsibility and external handoff
blocks.guidance: A routing field records ownership; it does not decide disputed responsibility.

blocks.label: Senior Housing coordination facts and unresolved questions
blocks.guidance: Separate observed facts from assumptions and identify the next authorized reviewer.

fields.label: Property-specific facts, limitations, handoff details, and unresolved question

blocks.label: Visit and assessment record
blocks.guidance: Record qualifications or vendor status by reference when required.

blocks.label: Finding and proposed-work register
blocks.guidance: Route regulated, hazardous, or specialist work before authorization.

blocks.label: Scope and authorization
blocks.guidance: This row records an authorized operational decision; it does not establish liability.

blocks.label: Access failure, changed scope, delay, or escalation
blocks.guidance: Stop and route work that exceeds authority, qualification, consent, or approved scope.

fields.label: Condition, immediate action, owner, due point, escalation route, and planned disposition

sections.title: Completion, verification, and accountable closeout
sections.guidance: Close only after function and handoff are verified.

blocks.label: Completed work and verification
blocks.guidance: Record temporary work and permanent work as separate actions.

blocks.label: Closeout verification
blocks.guidance: A completed checklist does not replace specialist certification or resident acceptance.
items: Affected function was tested within the worker's authority
Temporary controls and remaining limitations are documented
Area was left secure, accessible, and appropriately clean
Resident, tenant, guest, or business contact received an update
Keys, credentials, tools, materials, and vendor access were reconciled
Warranty, invoice, work order, and evidence references are linked
Every unresolved item has an owner, due point, and escalation route
Required follow-up or reinspection date is scheduled

blocks.label: Outcome and handoff
blocks.guidance: Do not mark closed while a required action lacks ownership.

blocks.label: Remaining limitation, resident response, and next action
blocks.guidance: Preserve disagreement or correction requests without changing the original evidence.

fields.label: Unresolved condition, current control, owner, due point, handoff, and final disposition path

blocks.label: Work record preparation and qualified review
blocks.guidance: Signatures acknowledge preparation and review of the record, not waiver or legal acceptance.
